note: `rocq compile` rejects this file outright ("The section S needs to be closed.") because coqc ends the library; the comparator's in-process driver stops at end of file, so it must catch the open section itself. Two independent checks do. The axiom check runs first in the pipeline and wins here: the proof term contains Var H, reported as a section variable -> forbidden_axiom. Envcheck's section hygiene (Lib.sections_are_opened, Lib.current_mp, const_hyps) is the second net and reports unsafe_flags; it is what catches an open Section or Module whose hypotheses the proof does not use (verified by hand: a solution with an unused open section gives "the solution ends with a section still open", an open Module gives "the solution ends inside Challenge.M").
